answer: Make every identity climb a trellis of consecutive epochs: its reward share starts at zero and rises only while it answers each epoch, resetting to zero after one missed epoch. A lotus blooming once earns nothing; only sustained, on-time work counts. One honest agent tending a single streak costs almost nothing, while a farm must keep a thousand identities answering every epoch, on schedule, forever — each wander from the schedule wipes its progress. Graders sample streaks at random, and a template answer breaks the streak, so bulk clones pay full attendance cost for near-zero reward.
